A quick storm check for your garage door 🌀

It's the largest opening that moves on your house, so it's worth a look before the next system heads for Miami:

1. Scan the panels for dents, bowing or rust
2. Make sure the tracks are straight and tight
3. Run one full open-and-close cycle
4. Wave something in front of the sensor eye
5. Check the bottom seal

See frayed cables or gapped springs? Don't touch them. Call a pro.

Full checklist on the 305doors.com blog. Link in bio.
